instructions: Display this bundled ClawHub metadata entry from the local SDKWork Skills seed.
Do not execute remote code from this artifact until the community package has passed SDKWork review.
Use when the user wants a cited, structured read of local documents and project knowledge. Triggers on: "analyze these docs", "scan my project for context",...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of artifact-analysis skill.

- Provides a structured, citation-backed analysis of local documents and project knowledge.
- Produces all output on disk: creates a scan plan, parallel subagent findings, and a synthesized report, each with sources.
- Supports intent-driven or generic extraction over user-specified paths or auto-discovered project knowledge folders.
- Strictly does not process codebase lookups, web searches, document editing, OCR, or remote sources—local plain text and markdown only.
- Enforces an auditable four-step workflow with verification and failure-mode reporting.
- Designed for invocation by users or programmatically by other beagle skills; never returns inline prose.
